draft.subject: Interest in future firmware openings at Ommo
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across the Senior Firmware Engineer posting at Ommo, and since it asks for more experience than I currently have, I wanted to reach out to you about any other paths onto the team.

My background is in low level embedded systems, including bare metal C on STM32 peripherals such as timers and ADC, and FreeRTOS based systems with mutex protected task coordination for sensor driven control. I have also designed and fabricated my own PCBs and wired up sensor communication over UART and I2C end to end.

What Ommo is building with magnetic tracking for surgical and robotics applications is the kind of precision embedded problem I want to work on, and I would appreciate being considered if any earlier career firmware openings come up down the line.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
